title: Oracle Manifest for Capability Studio Gate A1
description: Oracle Manifest structure for Gate A1. Full expression of 04 §3.1: fixtureCorpusRoot, ciRoot, instance, launcher, runtimeIdentity, expectedOutputs, detachedSignature. releaseStatus is NON_RELEASE only. Payload/signature boundary is clear. NON_RELEASE only. Draft 2020-12.

oracleId.description: Unique identifier for this oracle instance.

oracleType.description: Type of oracle. Closed enum. Per 04 §2.1.

releaseStatus.description: Release status. NON_RELEASE is the only allowed value for Target A1 oracles. Per 04 §2.1.

fixtureCorpusRoot.description: Relative path to the fixture corpus root within the source package. Per 04 §3.1.

ciRoot.description: Relative path to the CI Merkle tree root artifact. Per 04 §3.1.

launcher.description: How the oracle is launched. Per 04 §3.1.

runtimeIdentity.description: Runtime identity of the oracle execution environment. Per 04 §3.1.

expectedOutputs.description: Expected outputs of the oracle execution. Per 04 §3.1.

detachedSignature.description: Ed25519 detached signature over the oracle payload, excluding this detachedSignature field itself. Payload/signature boundary is explicit. NON_RELEASE only. Per 04 §3.1.

corpusRootDigest.description: Content digest of the corpus root this instance was built from. Per 04 §3.1.

parentCommitSha.description: Git commit SHA of the parent oracle this was derived from. Per 04 §3.1.

generatedAt.description: ISO-8601 instant when this instance was generated. Per 04 §3.1.

snapshotTimestamp.description: ISO-8601 instant of the runtime snapshot used by this instance. Per 04 §3.1.

env.description: Environment variables for the launcher. Key-value pairs of string to string. Per 04 §3.1.

corpusRoot.description: Relative path to the corpus root used by the launcher. Per 04 §3.1.

oracleRuntimeIdentity.description: Runtime identity of the oracle execution environment. Per 04 §3.1.

interpreterVersion.description: Semantic version of the runtime interpreter. Per 04 §3.1.

sha256.description: Content digest of the interpreter/runtime binary. Per 04 §3.1.

oracleExpectedOutput.description: A single expected output entry from oracle execution. Per 04 §3.1.

fixturePath.description: Relative path to the expected fixture artifact. Per 04 §3.1.

contentDigest.description: Expected content digest of the output artifact. Per 04 §3.1.

expectedOutcome.description: Expected outcome for this output. Per 04 §3.1.

expectedErrorCode.description: Expected error code string when outcome is REJECT; null if outcome is PASS. Per 04 §3.1.

ed25519DetachedSignature.description: Ed25519 detached signature. algorithm=Ed25519, keyId identifies the signing key, signatureBase64 is the Base64-encoded Ed25519 signature over the oracle payload (excluding this detachedSignature field). NON_RELEASE only. Per 04 §3.1.

algorithm.description: Signing algorithm identifier. Must be Ed25519. Per 04 §3.1.

keyId.description: Identifier of the signing key used. Per 04 §3.1.

signatureBase64.description: Ed25519 signature as Base64-encoded bytes (R||S, 64 bytes). Per 04 §3.1.
